edits.new:
The integration dependencies are RWB-P5-E1024-APP, RWB-P3-E1018-APP and RWB-P1-E1001-APP.

Open decisions DL10 (Thai names for fields, labels and messages), DL11 (non-functional target values) and DL27 (storage, backup, legal hold and e-discovery for the document hub) apply to this story. The story builds on their recorded assumptions, confirmed by the programme directive of 26 November 2026: DL10 on ASM-2250, ASM-2357, ASM-2377 and ASM-2863; DL11 on ASM-0553, ASM-0703, ASM-1051 and ASM-1104; DL27 on ASM-1771, ASM-2532, ASM-2709 and ASM-2716. The decisions themselves remain open with their owners, and none of them blocks the build of this suite.
